snippet.title: Floors of Fate - Official Trailer | Dark Fantasy Action RPG
snippet.description:
Ascend the tower. Defy fate.

Floors of Fate is a dark fantasy Action RPG and Dungeon Crawler where you climb a massive 50-floor tower filled with ancient horrors, deadly enemies, hidden story fragments, and challenging boss encounters.

Fight your way through shifting biomes, master timing-based hack & slash combat, discover powerful runes, and survive the unforgiving trials of the tower.

Wishlist Floors of Fate on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4291840/Floors_of_Fate/

Download the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4560100/Floors_of_Fate_Demo/
